paragraphs: R' Yehoshua bar Avayin — Yoma, chapter 3, end of halakhah 5.[^1][^2]

notes.text: סה״ה is conventionally read as end of halakhah 5, correcting the older note’s סעיף/הלכה gloss and omitted end. The chapter/halakhah format suggests Yerushalmi, without independently verified edition mapping.
The abbreviated title stays R'. Heading and body אביין are retained as Avayin, distinct from the older Avin transliteration; no further identity is established.
